outputs: Generated answers and explanations for qualification exam questions

changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard capitalization formats (e.g., ChatGLM3 instead of Chat-GLM3, DeepSeek-v2 instead of Deepseek-v2, LLaMA-7B instead of LLaMa-7B). All extracted items were accurate and relevant.

Normalized metric names to standard capitalization (Accuracy instead of accuracy) and simplified 'F1 score' to 'F1'. Both metrics are explicitly mentioned in the paper for evaluating generated answers.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges to evaluate generated outputs. LLMs are only used as generators for qualification exam questions. No LLM-based evaluation methods or criteria are mentioned.

guideline: assessing question relevance and QA pair completeness

changes_made.explanation: Removed incorrectly extracted human evaluation items. The text mentions 'validated by two domain experts per field' but this refers to dataset construction/validation, not evaluation of LLM-generated outputs. No human evaluation of generated answers is conducted.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on benchmarking LLMs on Chinese qualification exam questions (question answering task). It uses automatic metrics (Accuracy, F1) but does not employ LLM-as-judge or human evaluation for the generated outputs. The extraction was generally accurate except for human evaluation, which confused dataset validation with output evaluation.
